title: TRIZ for Digital Systems
subtitle: Contradiction-driven design for IT, business processes and AI
principle: Do not start from a product. Define the useful function, expose the contradiction, separate the conflict, scan existing resources, generate different system shapes, allocate mechanism and authority deliberately, then test both sides of the contradiction.

framework_steps.name: Frame the job and useful function
questions: What is inside and outside the boundary?

framework_steps.name: Define the ideal result
questions: What new coordination, state, ownership, manual work, runtime cost, or irreversible risk should not be required?

framework_steps.name: Name the contradiction
framework_steps.physical_template: The same element should be {state_a} under {condition_a} and should be {state_b} under {condition_b}.

framework_steps.name: Apply separation operators
questions: Can the conflict be separated by time?

framework_steps.name: Scan system resources
questions: What time or waiting window exists?
Which human judgment is still valuable?
Which policies and permissions already exist?
Where should compute and attention be spent?

framework_steps.name: Map and generate system shapes
framework_steps.option_rule: Generate at least two materially different system shapes; for complex problems prefer remove_or_simplify, deterministic_redesign and uncertainty_assisted_redesign.

framework_steps.name: Allocate technology and authority
framework_steps.rule: Use deterministic mechanisms for deterministic constraints. Use probabilistic mechanisms only where interpretation or uncertainty creates value. Allocate read, propose, validate, approve and execute separately when useful.

ideality_heuristic.statement: Useful outcome and reliability should improve faster than the complexity tax.
ideality_heuristic.warning: This is a qualitative design heuristic, not a numerical formula.

separation_operators.name: Separate by time
separation_operators.question: Must the conflicting properties be active at the same moment?

separation_operators.name: Separate by condition
separation_operators.question: Does every case need the same expensive or restrictive behavior?

separation_operators.name: Separate by context
separation_operators.question: Which behavior is common and which depends on valid local context?

separation_operators.name: Separate by system level
separation_operators.question: Is the contradiction being solved at the wrong level?

separation_operators.name: Separate by authority
separation_operators.question: Does the component that understands the situation also need permission to change it?

separation_operators.name: Separate by representation
separation_operators.question: Does every consumer need the full raw data?

contradiction_types.name: Local optimization vs end-to-end outcome
examples: department KPI vs process lead time

authority_chain.purpose: prepare classification, plan or exact change object
check exact rules, authorization, schema and preconditions
resolve remaining value or risk decision

authority_chain.default_control: narrow auditable idempotent tool when possible

ai_boundary_rules: Keep identity and authorization outside model control.
Keep exact calculations and mandatory thresholds deterministic.
Keep durable state in application storage, not model memory alone.
Treat retrieved and tool-returned text as untrusted data, not instructions.
Prefer broad read access and narrow write access for agents.
Separate investigation, prepared change, validation, approval and execution for high-impact actions.
Define budgets and explicit stop states for agent loops.
Evaluate outcome, evidence and trajectory separately.
Treat MCP and A2A as interoperability boundaries, not as substitutes for business authority design.

risk_tiers.name: Business-significant change
risk_tiers.default_control: prepared change + preconditions + explicit approval + idempotent execution

risk_tiers.name: High-impact or irreversible change
risk_tiers.side_effect: financial, legal, security, safety or difficult recovery
risk_tiers.default_control: human accountable decision; AI may advise but should not own authorization

rules: Do not choose a vendor or product before the contradiction, separation test and resource scan are explicit.
Test all six separation operators briefly before selecting one or more.
Generate at least two materially different system-shape options when evidence allows.
For complex problems prefer a remove-or-simplify option, a deterministic redesign, and an uncertainty-assisted option.
For every improvement metric include at least one counter-metric.
Do not grant an AI system authority merely because it can propose the action.
Prefer reversible experiments before production mutation.
Return unknowns and missing evidence explicitly rather than filling gaps with plausible text.

current_signals.rule: Treat current protocols and vendor capabilities as dated solution-space signals, not durable framework law.

data_artifacts.purpose: Reusable digital transformation patterns and graph links.
JSON Schema for inspectable contradiction-driven reasoning output.
